facts.fact: The strategy states that the first national ICT Policy was released in 2009 and reviewed in 2017, and its timeline lists a 2nd national ICT Policy in 2017.
The strategy states that in the absence of a national ICT strategy, MDAs have been operating on internal strategies; no date is given, so the document's published date of 2022-12 applies.

The strategy states that the Ministry of Information and Communications is mandated to provide policy and technical leadership and to implement, monitor and review the national ICT strategy; no date is given, so the published date of 2022-12 applies.
